Name: Clothes Rack
Author: LvnaticShade
Description:
Clothes Rack

:: FEATURES ::
Adds a single new furniture item: a clothes rack.
By right clicking you can "hang" your current hat, shirt and pants onto the rack.
If there are clothing items on the rack the farmer will wear them. So you can quickly "swap"
your current outfit.
Currently, the rack is sold by Robin in her carpenter's shop.

[b]Stardew Valley 1.6. introduced [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Mannequins]Mannequins[/url]﻿ which basically work the same as the racks from this mod. So most likely there is no more need for this mod.[/b]

Regarding savegame compatibility:
This mod will *not* hijack your savegame, so you can remove it at any time.
When loading a game without the mod present all empty clothes racks will be chicken statues and all racks which held items will be chests containing these items.

The rack's sprite is taken from: https://opengameart.org/content/clothing-rack. However, as it does not really fit the game's looks it is merely a placeholder. If you know a better free-to-use sprite for a clothes rack or want to contribute to this mod by providing one created by you, please contact me. This would be much appreciated.
